cat > think.py <<'PY'
import socket,time,sys,json
import arena,chess
b=arena.load_board()
t=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 60
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(a):s.sendall((a+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('uciok'):break
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('readyok'):break
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(t*1000))+(' searchmoves '+' '.join(sys.argv[2:]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else ''))
last='';start=time.time()
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('info depth'):last=l.strip()
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(last);print(l.strip());best=l.split()[1];break
send('quit')
open('analysis.json','w').write(json.dumps({'fen':b.fen(),'best':best,'info':last}))
print('SAN',b.san(chess.Move.from_uci(best)))

 data=json.load(open('analysis.json'))

 print('Board:',b.fen(),'Last move:',b.peek().uci(),'Result:',arena.result(b),flush=True)
 if arena.result(b):break
